manifest.title: Coordinator home
manifest.action: Review live and preparing events; choose Riverside.

manifest.title: Choose the organisation
manifest.action: Choose the organisation responsible for this event.

manifest.title: Name the event and venue
manifest.action: Fill the event name and venue; expand optional details if needed.

manifest.title: Dates and operating hours
manifest.action: Set local event dates, opening hours and timezone.

manifest.title: Review the draft event
manifest.action: Check the organisation, venue and dates before creating the draft.

manifest.title: Describe the operating plan
manifest.action: Enter event requirements and save the setup description.

manifest.title: Write the event brief
manifest.action: Save clear operating requirements before asking AI to draft the plan.

manifest.title: Supporting documents
manifest.action: Choose and upload original plans, procedures or supporting documents.

manifest.title: Select a supporting document
manifest.action: Choose the original and set its title and document type before uploading.

manifest.title: AI planning assistant
manifest.action: Generate a candidate operating plan and answer any clarification questions.

manifest.title: Review the operating plan
manifest.action: Review proposed records, resolve issues and verify the plan before recruitment.

manifest.title: Place the site on the map
manifest.action: Inspect or position locations and staffing posts on the event map.

manifest.title: Locations and staffing posts
manifest.action: Review areas, posts, coverage and qualification requirements.

manifest.title: Operating hours and procedures
manifest.action: Confirm operating windows and the procedures volunteers must acknowledge.

manifest.title: Recruitment and join code
manifest.action: Publish recruitment after verification; share the join code with volunteers.

manifest.title: Event team and permissions
manifest.action: Find a member and review their event role.

manifest.title: Review event access
manifest.action: Set roles only for people who need coordinator or safety-lead permissions.

manifest.title: Crew qualifications
manifest.action: Inspect extracted certificate details before human approval.

manifest.title: Human certificate review
manifest.action: Compare extracted fields with the original; record the review before approving.

manifest.title: Certificate approved
manifest.action: Human approval is recorded; event-date validity remains a separate deterministic check.

manifest.title: Generate and review the roster
manifest.action: Generate shift times, assign eligible crew, resolve coverage gaps and publish.

manifest.title: Event tools
manifest.action: Find setup, site, recruitment and operational tools in grouped sections.

manifest.title: Event overview and next step
manifest.action: Use the event stage to decide whether to finish setup, review crew or open Alerts.

manifest.title: Coordinator updates
manifest.action: Open qualification warnings or other operational updates.

manifest.title: Check readiness and start operations
manifest.action: Check acknowledgements and certificates; choose a no-show grace period before starting.

manifest.title: Prioritise incidents and risks
manifest.action: Review urgency colours, severity labels and the most urgent incident first.

manifest.title: Read the original and AI interpretation
manifest.action: Preserve the original report; confirm or correct the AI interpretation before responding.

manifest.title: Assess emerging risk evidence
manifest.action: Read supporting reports and confirm conditions on site.

manifest.title: Review the proposed response
manifest.action: AI drafts a response; no crew move occurs until a person approves.

manifest.title: Select eligible crew
manifest.action: Review destination, instructions, qualifications and current coverage.

manifest.title: Understand unavailable crew
manifest.action: Blocked candidates show the constraint that prevents a safe move.

manifest.title: Approve the chosen response
manifest.action: Read who will move and approve the selected volunteer; source coverage is rechecked.

manifest.title: Track the instruction
manifest.action: Review the approved response and the volunteer’s acknowledgement status.

manifest.title: Crowd control
manifest.action: Inspect advisory camera estimates and crowding alerts; verify on the ground.

manifest.title: Camera reading and trend
manifest.action: Review count, density, trend and freshness before requesting a response.

manifest.title: Weather and advisory signals
manifest.action: Review modelled weather and unverified social information as advisory context.

manifest.title: Demo social feed
manifest.action: Original social posts remain synthetic and unverified.

manifest.title: Record a measured site observation
manifest.action: Add the location and observed facts so the risk review has a grounded source.

manifest.title: Review operational history
manifest.action: Keep incident receipt, human decisions and assignment changes visible.

manifest.title: Enter the event code
manifest.action: Use the join code supplied by the coordinator.

manifest.title: Confirm the event
manifest.action: Check the event name, location and dates before joining.

manifest.title: Reusable certificate library
manifest.action: Upload qualifications once; each event checks its own requirements.

manifest.title: Choose certificate evidence
manifest.action: Select the original certificate, name it and save it for extraction and human review.

manifest.title: Update availability and preferences
manifest.action: Change availability before roster generation and review event instructions.

manifest.title: Published shifts
manifest.action: Review time, location, instructions, supervisor and escalation contact.

manifest.title: Switch the selected event
manifest.action: Choose which event your shifts and event tools belong to.

manifest.title: Profile and emergency details
manifest.action: Keep contact details, emergency contact and certificates up to date.

manifest.title: Create a coordinator workspace
manifest.action: After shared account onboarding, create your organisation from Profile.

manifest.title: Volunteer updates
manifest.action: Read new shift or coordinator instructions.

manifest.title: Event and current assignment
manifest.action: See your current assignment, incident reporting and event preparation.

manifest.title: Arrive and check in
manifest.action: Check in to the current assignment so the coordinator sees coverage.

manifest.title: Check-in confirmed
manifest.action: Your assignment now shows checked in.

manifest.title: Report an incident
manifest.action: Give the location, what happened and urgent details; typing and voice are available.

manifest.title: Report received; AI follows
manifest.action: Receipt is shown before AI analysis; the original report is retained.

manifest.title: Receive an approved instruction
manifest.action: Read the coordinator-approved reassignment; accept or decline.

manifest.title: Confirm response completion
manifest.action: Review field updates and record completion notes.

manifest.title: Review the event summary
manifest.action: Edit the AI draft, confirm follow-up and close the event yourself.

manifest.title: Event closed
manifest.action: Event closeout is confirmed while the operational record remains available.
